attchmntText: Ruchira Papers Limited has informed the exchange regarding the Newspaper Publication pertaining to unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30.09.2026
voiceSummary: Ruchi Ira Papers Limited filed a notice with BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited regarding the newspaper publication of un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The public advertisement was released in Financial Express and Jansatta on 14th November 2026. The company scrip code is 532785 and trading symbol is RUCHIRA EQ. The filing was signed by Iqbal Singh, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: INTIMATION OF RECONSTITUTION OF STAKEHOLDERS RELATIONSHIP COMMITTEE UNDER REGULATION 30 OF SEBI (LISTING OBLIGATIONS AND DISCLOSURE REQUIREMENTS) REGULATIONS, 2015.
voiceSummary: Ruchiira Papers Limited has reconstituted its Stakeholder Relationship Committee with effect from 13th November 2026. The Board of Directors approved this change during its meeting held on 13th November 2026. The committee composition includes Sh. Kamal Sharma as Chairman, who is an Independent Director. Sh. Subhash Chander Garg serves as Co-Chairman and Director. Sh. Jatinder Singh is listed as the Managing Director and Member. Sh. Deepan Garg is the Member. The filing was submitted to BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations. The company scrip code is 532785. The trading symbol is RUCHIRA EQ. The notice was issued on 13th November 2026.

attchmntText: Ruchira Papers Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Ruchira Papers Limited announced the outcome of its Board of Directors meeting held on 13th November 2026. The Board approved the Un-Audited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026, accompanied by a Limited Review Report. The company reported a profit before tax of 129.42 million for the quarter ended 30th September 2026, compared to 78.18 million in the previous year. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, profit before tax was 300.43 million, versus 298.45 million in the prior period. Earnings per share for the quarter were 1.10 basic and diluted. The Board also reconstituted the Stakeholders Relationship Committee by adding Mr. Deepan Garg as a member effective 13th November 2026. The meeting commenced at 12.00 PM and concluded at 01:05 PM.
